cover letter
High school diploma or equivalent experience
Demonstrated experience in event planning and coordination
Previous office experience and event coordination

The Operations Assistant reports to the Director of Operations and performs a variety of moderately complex to difficult administrative tasks to support the Labor Center, and if needed, will also support individual programs/teams. The position regularly works on tasks that are varied and complex, applies the full range of specialized skills and job knowledge, frequently adapts procedures, techniques, tools, materials, and/or equipment to meet specialized needs, performs broad and/or focused assignments under general supervision, and relies on experience and judgment to plan and accomplish assigned tasks.
Staff and Academic Search Coordination - 25%

With direction from the Director of Operations, coordinate selected phases of the staff and non-senate academic search and appointment process to include, but not limited to, ad placement, documentation collection, updating AP Recruit and TAM, and conducting search closure activities.
Student-Employee Recruitment and Hiring - 25%

With direction from the Director of Operations and collaboration with SHARE HR, coordinate student-employee recruitment & hiring process to include but not limited to: collect appointment information; complete IRLE Hiring Smartsheet; complete MLA and Fee Remission Transfer forms; create and distribute Reader/Tutor appointment letters. Be an information resource for students and hiring managers
Travel and Reimbursement Coordination - 15%
Coordinate travel and reimbursement activities for Center staff, students, and guests.
Student Stipend and Honorarium Processing - 10%
Coordinate Student Stipend and Honorarium Requests; collect paperwork; submit requests in BearBUY; provide customer service support; update tracking log.
IT and Facility Service Coordination - 10%
Coordinates IT or Facility Service Requests as needed. Conduct office setup for new hires and office moves. Maintain office equipment inventory.
Program Logistics and Event Support - 10%

Coordinate basic program logistics and event support, for the Labor Center as a whole or for a program/team, such as conferences, staff events and ad hoc meetings/events (e.g., find and book venues, room set-up and break down, order catering and submit required documentation: EPO, Guestlist, sign-in sheet, etc, AV equipment, and materials). Completes and processes all documents for Lead Admin review (alcohol permit, insurance, site agreements, etc)
Administrative Files and Data Maintenance - 5%
Maintain Labor Center administrative shared files and data sources, such as Salesforce and Google Drive
Excellent customer service orientation, initiative, and follow-up
Interest in labor issues and workforce development program development, and social and economic justice.
Understanding of the work and activities of labor research and education organizations such as CLRE, and of the organized labor and community constituencies served by CLRE.
Solid knowledge of Microsoft Office and software
Working knowledge of common campus-specific application programs and/or the ability to learn.
Solid communication and interpersonal skills to communicate effectively with all levels of staff and external constituencies, both verbal and in writing
Solid organizational skills and ability to work within demanding timeframes/time management skills
Ability to manage competing deadlines and attention to high levels of detail and accuracy
Ability to manage a project including assessing when to make adjustments as the project is underway
Ability to use discretion and maintain all confidentiality
Ability to use sound judgment in responding to issues and concerns
Ability to provide audio-visual support and troubleshoot moderate technical issues related to event production, staging, etc.), including Zoom
Ability to follow directions and work with little supervision in a fast-paced environment with shifting priorities
Ability to interact with a diverse population in a dynamic work environment
Ability to listen and incorporate feedback from LC program/project Leads
